metadata.description: {\rtf1\ansi\fs24{\fs48\b MC Scripts\b}\line\line Unified ReaPack repository for REAPER scripts and effects developed by MC Scripts.\line\line Import this ReaPack repository:\line\line \i\ul text https://github.com/Echo722/MC-Scripts/raw/main/index.xml \ul0\i0 \line\line Scripts install under:\line\line \i\ul text REAPER/Scripts/MC Scripts Release/<script-folder>/ \ul0\i0 \line\line Effects (JSFX) install under:\line\line \i\ul text REAPER/Effects/MC Scripts Release/<effect-folder>/ \ul0\i0 \line\line {\fs24\b Packages\b}\line\line {\par \bullet\tab MediaEye: Media Explorer album art viewer for embedded and sidecar cover images.\line \bullet\tab TonalReducer (effect, beta): MC Tonal Reducer turns down sustained tones, notes, chords and glides in sound effects while keeping impacts and noise texture. It is a pre-release, so install it from the package browser with right-click > Versions...\line \bullet\tab ChannelFit: MC ChannelFit batch-exports regions as mono or stereo files depending on whether their left and right channels actually differ. Requires ReaImGui and js_ReaScriptAPI.\line \bullet\tab ItemArrange: MC ItemArrange lays selected items out at a fixed interval and snaps each one's left edge to the grid line on its left, with an optional snap toggle. Requires ReaImGui.\line }\line {\fs24\b Release Convention\b}\line\line Packages in this repository use:\line\line {\par \bullet\tab Author: \i\ul MC Scripts\ul0\i0 \line \bullet\tab Repository name: \i\ul MC Scripts Release\ul0\i0 \line \bullet\tab Category: \i\ul <script-folder>\ul0\i0 (or \i\ul <effect-folder>\ul0\i0 )\line \bullet\tab Source file paths: direct package files such as \i\ul MediaEye.lua\ul0\i0 or \i\ul MC_TonalReducer.jsfx\ul0\i0 \line }\line }

version.author: MC Scripts
version.changelog: Move the ReaPack install path to MC Scripts Release/MediaEye so MC Scripts releases are grouped together.

version.author: MC Scripts
version.changelog: Pin On Top now stays topmost only while REAPER is the foreground app, so it no longer covers other programs (e.g. a browser) when you switch away, and it re-pins automatically when REAPER regains focus. ---- Pin On Top(置顶)改为仅在 REAPER 处于前台时生效,切到浏览器等其它程序时不再遮挡,切回 REAPER 时自动重新置顶。

version.author: MC Scripts
version.changelog: Always-on smart pinning: the window stays on top only inside REAPER and hides itself automatically while another application is in the foreground, reappearing pinned when REAPER returns. The Pin On Top toggle button has been removed. ---- 置顶改为始终开启的智能行为:仅在 REAPER 内保持最上层,切到其它程序时窗口自动隐藏,切回 REAPER 自动恢复置顶;移除 Pin On Top 开关按钮。

version.author: MC Scripts
version.changelog: Cover priority: an image explicitly named as cover art (Artwork/Cover/Folder/Front/...) found on the folder chain now wins over the embedded picture. Fixes packs (e.g. SwishSwoosh) that embed a label logo into every file while the real pack cover sits in the root as Artwork.png. Unnamed nearby images still rank below the embedded picture. ---- 封面优先级调整:文件夹链上找到明确以 Artwork/Cover/Folder/Front 等命名的封面图时,优先于音频内嵌图显示(修复 SwishSwoosh 等每个文件都内嵌厂牌 logo 而真封面在根目录 Artwork.png 的包);未明确命名的普通图片仍低于内嵌图。

version.author: MC Scripts
version.changelog: The window now stays above the Media Explorer only, instead of above every REAPER window: clicking an FX (or any other) window brings it over the cover art as usual, so large plugin UIs are no longer obstructed. The above-ME ordering is maintained natively by Windows (owner attachment), so clicking around the Media Explorer causes no flicker. Hiding when another application is in the foreground is unchanged. ---- 窗口置顶范围收窄:只保持在 Media Explorer 之上,不再压住所有 REAPER 窗口——点击 FX 等其它窗口可正常盖住封面图,大插件界面不再被挡;在 ME 上层的排序由 Windows 原生维持(owner 挂接),点击 ME 无闪烁;切到其它程序时自动隐藏的行为保持不变。

version.name: 0.1.0beta2
version.author: MC Scripts
version.changelog: First public beta of MC Tonal Reducer, a JSFX for sound design that turns down tonal content (sustained tones, short notes, chords and glides) while keeping impacts and noise texture. Stereo-linked partial tracking; transient protection that also suppresses pre-echo before attacks and leaves already-sounding tones alone; Processed / Original / Removed monitoring with identical latency (64 ms at 48 kHz); a scalable UI with a live spectrum. Requires REAPER 7.0+. This is a pre-release: in the package browser, right-click TonalReducer > Versions... to install it. Since the 0.1.0beta1 zip, Reduction is a percentage (0-100%, default 50%); projects saved with beta1 need it set again (6 dB = 50%, 12 dB = 75%, 24 dB = 94%). ---- MC Tonal Reducer 首个公开测试版：用于音效设计的音调抑制 JSFX，削弱持续音、短音符、和弦与滑音，同时保留冲击和噪声质感。左右声道联动的分音跟踪；瞬态保护会抑制起音前的预回声，且不会把已经在持续的音调放回；处理后／原音／移除部分三种试听延迟一致（48 kHz 下 64 ms）；界面可缩放，带实时频谱。需要 REAPER 7.0 以上。这是预发布版本：请在包浏览器里右键 TonalReducer，选 Versions... 安装。相对 0.1.0beta1 压缩包：削弱力度改为百分比（0–100%，默认 50%），用 beta1 保存的工程需要重新设置（6 dB≈50%，12 dB≈75%，24 dB≈94%）。

version.author: MC Scripts
version.changelog: First release of MC ChannelFit. Batch-exports regions with the channel count each file actually needs: a dry run measures the master mix of every region, regions whose left and right channels carry the same signal are rendered as mono files and all others stay stereo. One-sided, silent and incompletely measured regions are flagged and kept stereo; every region can be overridden by hand. Format, file names and output folder come from the project's render settings, which are restored afterwards. Works with Master mix or a region render matrix that uses only the Master column, bounds All regions / Selected regions, stereo channels. Requires REAPER 7.62+, ReaImGui 0.10+ and js_ReaScriptAPI. ---- MC ChannelFit 首个正式版。按 Region 批量导出时，按实际内容决定每个文件用单声道还是立体声：先 Dry run 测量每个 Region 的 Master 混音，左右声道内容相同的导成单声道，其余保持立体声。单侧有声、静音和没测全的 Region 会单独标出并保持立体声，每个 Region 都可以手动指定声道。格式、文件名和输出目录沿用工程的渲染设置，导完恢复原样。支持渲染源为 Master mix 或只勾了 Master 列的 Region 渲染矩阵、渲染范围为所有 Region 或选中的 Region、声道为立体声。需要 REAPER 7.62 以上、ReaImGui 0.10 以上和 js_ReaScriptAPI。

version.author: MC Scripts
version.changelog: Supports a secondary render format. When the project renders a second format (e.g. WAV + MP3), every region is exported once per format and the mono/stereo choice applies to both. The pre-export check verifies each format covers every region and blocks the export if one does not; the confirm dialog shows the formats and existing files per format; the log reports each pass per format, and a pass in which one format wrote nothing counts as failed. Changing the secondary format after the dry run is detected like other render settings. ---- 支持渲染设置里的第二输出格式。工程开了第二格式（例如 WAV + MP3）时，每个 Region 每种格式各导出一个文件，单声道/立体声的判定对两种格式都生效。导出前预检会确认每种格式都覆盖了所有 Region，有缺漏就不允许导出；确认框显示导出格式和按格式统计的同名文件数；日志按格式列出每一遍的结果，某一种格式一个文件都没写出时这一遍算作失败。Dry run 之后改了第二格式，会和其它渲染设置一样被检测出来。

version.author: MC Scripts
version.changelog: Fix: the Export button was clickable before any analysis and then failed with a script error (attempt to index a nil value 'analysis'). Export is now disabled until a region analysis exists, and its tooltip asks to run the analysis first. ---- 修复：还没分析时「导出」按钮也能点，点了会报脚本错误（attempt to index a nil value 'analysis'）。现在没有分析结果时「导出」按钮是灰的，悬停提示先点「分析」。

version.author: MC Scripts
version.changelog: First release of MC ItemArrange. Lays selected media items out at a fixed interval and snaps every item so its left edge sits on the grid line to its left. One dialog with two modes: Item end (each item starts a fixed number of seconds after the previous item ended, so unequal lengths never overlap) and Item start (each item starts a fixed number of seconds after the previous item started). Snap to grid is ticked by default and can be unticked to lay items out at exactly the interval without quantising. The first item keeps its position and merely snaps left; the rest follow in their current left-to-right order, across tracks. Locked items are skipped and reported, unselected members of a group follow it, and everything lands in a single undo step. The grid follows REAPER's current setting and snap tolerance is computed in the grid-index domain so items sitting exactly on a line are never pushed back a cell. Requires REAPER 6.0+ and ReaImGui 0.8+; SWS is optional but gives full grid support. ---- MC ItemArrange 首个版本。把选中的媒体对象按固定间隔摆开，同时让每个对象的左边界落在它左边的网格线上。一个对话框两个模式：结尾相隔（每个对象在上一个对象结尾之后固定秒数开始，长短不一也不会重叠）和起点相隔（比上一个对象起点晚固定秒数）。「Snap to grid」默认勾选，取消勾选就只按间隔精确摆开、不做量化。第一个对象保持原位、只向左吸附，其余按当前从左到右的顺序依次排列，可以跨轨道。锁定的对象跳过并提示，同组未选中的成员跟随，整次操作只产生一步撤销。网格跟随 REAPER 当前设置，吸附容差在网格索引域计算，正好压在网格线上的对象不会被多推一格。需要 REAPER 6.0 以上、ReaImGui 0.8 以上；SWS 可选，装了网格支持更全。

version.author: MC Scripts
version.changelog: New warm look for the Reposition Items dialog: cream background, espresso title bar and a single terracotta accent used only for what is selected or confirms - the chosen mode, the ticked Snap to grid box, the OK button and a thin rule under the title bar. Small rounded corners, roomier spacing and taller OK/Cancel buttons. Segoe UI is now the preferred font (Tahoma, then the built-in face, as fallbacks). Arranging behaviour is unchanged. ---- 「Reposition Items」对话框换成暖色外观：米白底、深咖啡标题栏，赤陶橙只用在选中和确认的地方——选中的模式、勾上的 Snap to grid、OK 按钮，以及标题栏下的一条细线。小圆角，间距更宽松，OK / Cancel 按钮更高。字体优先 Segoe UI（找不到时依次用 Tahoma、内置字体）。摆开逻辑没有变化。
